title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-01-17

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is decent despite some hiss/mud, capturing a high‑energy early‑68 show highlighted by a blazing Spanish Jam and the Dark Star > China Cat > Eleven sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with a scorching Spanish Jam, a tight Dark Star → China Cat → Eleven trio, and vibrant early‑68 psychedelia that many reviewers call “fucking amazing.” While the soundboard source suffers from occasional hiss and muddiness, it remains clear enough for the band’s brilliance to cut through. Overall the show is energetic, historic, and worth repeated listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars, praising musical highlights; recording quality is mixed but generally acceptable, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note hissy/muddy artifacts and later‑generation sourcing issues, but the mix remains clear enough for guitars and vocals to shine; no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The Dark Star → China Cat → Eleven sequence is praised as a jewel; the set flows with early psychedelic energy and foreshadows later 1968 explorations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s speedy Gibson work dominates, especially on the Spanish Jam and China Cat; his vocal on China Cat is highlighted as a standout moment.
